preamble: The shift from the diphthong [ou] (or [oʊ]) to the high back vowel [u] involves monophthongization and vowel raising, often seen in the contrast between standard and regional dialects.

examples.note: Attic ου monophthongized to [oː] and then raised to [uː] by the 4th century BC

sources: Wikipedia contributors (2026). Phonological history of French. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phonological_history_of_French
